title: Require independent cloud review and measured validation of self-improvements
goal: Assign an independent eligible working model to critique a candidate using the actual diff, requirements and tool receipts, with reviewer provenance separate from the implementer. Reviewer approval alone cannot pass: run exact task acceptance with nonzero tests, cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --workspace --locked. Compare behavior/quality/performance against a preserved baseline and held-out workload; reject regressions, missing checks and fabricated receipts. Test on an isolated dev instance where needed, never the installed release. Hermetic integration tests reject self-approval, false test claims and model-generated changes that fail execution. Implement nonzero tests named cloud_rsi_verification_* in susi-gawd exercising production wiring.
